items.description:

items.description:

items.title: Gujranwala, Multan overtake Lahore in air pollution
items.description:
LAHORE: Heavy smog pushed air quality in several Punjab cities into the hazardous category on Friday, with Lahore recording an hourly AQI reading of 465 between 7am and 8am, while Gujranwala and Multan registered readings of 661 and 641, respectively, according to real-time air quality data.
Lahore’s historical hourly air quality graph classified the reading of 465 as hazardous, indicating extremely polluted conditions and serious health risks for residents.

items.title: Provinces cannot assume ‘unexercised’ federal powers: FCC
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: The Federal Constitu­tional Court (FCC) has ruled that parliament’s failure to exercise a fiscal power does not mean that the subject has been transferred to the provinces.
“An identified conflict with a competent federal law attracts the consequence prescribed under Article 142 of the Constitution, meaning that the federal law will prevail whereas the provincial law becomes void to the extent of that conflict,” observed FCC Chief Justice Aminuddin Khan in a 59-page judgement authored by him.

items.title: $35bn per year needed for pre-primary education by 2030: Unesco report
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: Ensuring that every child benefits from at least one year of pre-primary education by 2030 would require more than $35 billion in additional annual investment globally, according to a new Unesco report released on the World Children’s Day on Friday.
Pre-primary enrolment rates have stalled over the past decade, and only 6 in 10 children entering primary school worldwide have attended at least one year of preschool, with major regional disparities.
The report shows that growing financing gaps and persistent inequalities continue to deprive millions of young children around the world
